title: Simultaneous de novo calling and phasing of genetic variants at chromosome-scale using NanoStrand-seq
boundary: Single-adaptor Tn5 entry and two sequential strand-tagging primer-extension rounds before long-fragment amplification; positive preparative boundary beyond merely moving Strand-seq reads onto ONT. Original detailed chemistry and inheritance still require curation.
evidence_scope: Published2024 primary publisher identity/abstract/workflow overview and PubMed38977679 checked; selected strand-tagging overview only. Publisher direct open redirected to identity gate but indexed primary overview readable; full source pass pending.

title: LABS: linear amplification-based bisulfite sequencing for ultrasensitive cancer detection from cell-free DNA
boundary: T7 adaptor tagging BEFORE bisulfite conversion and T7 RNA-polymerase IVT AFTER conversion provide linear amplification rather than repeatedly priming converted DNA. Distinct amplification/ordering boundary from conventional WGBS/PBAT; exact library geometry unreviewed.
evidence_scope: Published2024 primary publisher identity/abstract and LABS linear-amplification overview inspected. Published main publicly readable; supplements not inspected; no full chemistry or missing-information review.

title: Methyltransferase-assisted single duplex sequencing for detecting circulating tumor DNA
boundary: Physically links original Watson/Crick strands; CpG pre-methylation precedes enzymatic conversion and MspI reduction avoids end repair. Source explicitly distinguishes original-duplex genetic information from five-letter-seq single-strand genetic information. Boundary versus queued Methyl-CODEC remains source-qualified/provisional until detailed prep review.
evidence_scope: Published19Aug2026 primary publisher development overview and PubMed42618801 identity/abstract checked. No claimed universal transition correction. Direct nature.com open gated; primary Springer indexed overview available. Supplements/detailed recipe not inspected.

title: From single-molecule to genome-wide mapping of DNA lesions: repair-assisted damage detection sequencing
boundary: Repair-assisted lesion excision opens gaps for biotinylated-nucleotide repair synthesis, sonication and anti-biotin-antibody fragment enrichment before NGS; distinct physical repair-label/capture frontend rather than enzyme substitution in single-base nick mapping. Not the nonsequencing Rapid-RADD assay.
evidence_scope: Published2021 primary article identity/introduction and selected Results/Fig2 preparation overview inspected via PMC. Demonstrated NGS frontend only; no full methods/supplement reading or biochemical model.

title: Genomic sites hypersensitive to ultraviolet radiation
boundary: Lesion-specific nicking/photorepair followed by semirandom-primer extension creates a ligatable ds-end at the lesion; biotin linker tagging and subsequent shearing/capture distinguish it from CPD-seq adapter-first ss-end capture and circle-damage opening.
evidence_scope: Published2019 primary PNAS indexed Methods/figure1 overview and PubMed31723047 exact identity checked. PMC6883822 direct access browser-gated. No full original/supplement chemistry audit; existing CPD/CD neighbours not inherited.

title: DNA–Protein Cross-Linking Sequencing for Genome-Wide Mapping of Thymidine Glycol
boundary: NTHL1 removes thymidine glycol and its covalent AP-site intermediate is reductively trapped; Ni-NTA enrichment plus SDS-PAGE/membrane transfer selects enzyme–DNA conjugates before NGS. Different molecular capture from lesion-antibody IP and from endogenous-protein DPC precipitation below.
evidence_scope: Published2022 exact JACS identity/abstract via PubMed34978433 and associated primary PMC8755629 introduction/enrichment overview inspected; no complete recipe/supplement reading. DPC homonym explicitly separated.

title: Transcription-coupled repair of DNA–protein cross-links depends on CSA and CSB
boundary: Denaturing SDS lysis/shearing, KCl–SDS precipitation and reprecipitation enrich native/formaldehyde-induced DNA–protein crosslinks; proteinase K releases DNA for NGS. Physically distinct endogenous-conjugate selection from NTHL1 synthetic trapping. Concurrent Oka2024 DOI10.1038/s41556-024-01401-2 and later2025 DPC applications are not separate proposed entries.
evidence_scope: Published2024 primary publisher DPC-seq development overview/Fig6 and associated PMC11098753 identity checked. Concurrent2024 same-named primary overview checked solely for overlap; no complete original methods or supplements inspected.

title: Genome-wide mapping of protein–DNA damage interaction by PADD-seq
boundary: Protein ChIP and reverse crosslinking physically select protein-associated DNA BEFORE damage-antibody IP/polymerase-stall Damage-seq library preparation. Joint serial-selection frontend, not a new antibody target or computational intersection of independent ChIP/damage maps.
evidence_scope: Published2023 primary publisher conception overview/Fig1 and PubMed36715337 identity/abstract checked; associated PMC10085696 available. No full chemistry/supplement audit; Damage-seq inheritance remains component-scoped for later curation.
